commit.message:
Fix int16 overflow in the AVX2 natural-order DKE-512 NTT paths

The submitted build scripts define DKE_NTT512_PACKED and use the packed
AVX2 NTT, which reduces between layers and was not affected. Built without
that macro, parameters.h selects the natural-order intrinsic chain in
avx2/ntt_avx2.c, which had no reductions between layers and showed the same
int16 overflow as the scalar code (about one failure in 2,000 KEM
operations). The non-default DKE_NTT512_RB and DKE_NTT512_ASM forward
transforms had the same problem.

- Intrinsic chain: Barrett-reduce all coefficients after the len = 64 and
  len = 8 layers with AVX2 code that is bit-identical to the scalar
  DKE_barrett_reduce ((mulhi(a, v) + 2^9) >> 10, then a - t * q).
- DKE_NTT512_RB and DKE_NTT512_ASM: the forward NTT now uses the fixed
  intrinsic chain (bit-identical output); the inverse NTT and basemul are
  unchanged.
- The packed path (DKE_NTT512_PACKED) and the 128/256 instances are
  unchanged.

Verification:
- 700,000 forward transforms per configuration (random, extreme and
  worst-case inputs) are bit-identical to the fixed scalar NTT;
- DKEM-512: 0 failures in 20,000 runs per configuration (12 before) and in
  1,000,000 runs in the intrinsic configuration; ADKEX-512 and DKEX-512:
  0 failures in 20,000 handshakes per configuration;
- Tests/ntt512_regression fails before and passes after the fix on the
  optimized implementation built without DKE_NTT512_PACKED;
- KAT files byte-identical to Test_Vectors in all configurations.

@@ -23,5 +23,7 @@ It works for the reference, optimized (x86-64 AVX2) and AArch64 NEON implementat
 Cortex-M4 implementation is built for QEMU and is not covered by this script.
 
 The code before commit 8e3417a fails this test on the reference and NEON implementations.
-The optimized (AVX2) implementation was not affected by the overflow and passes it both
-before and after the fix.
+The optimized (AVX2) implementation as built by its build.sh (with DKE_NTT512_PACKED) was not
+affected and passes it both before and after that fix. Built without DKE_NTT512_PACKED, the
+optimized implementation uses a natural-order AVX2 NTT that failed this test until the
+follow-up AVX2 fix; it now passes in every configuration.
